entities.name: Katsuragawa Hoshū
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Katsuragawa Hoshū  was a Japanese physician and scholar of rangaku. He served the Tokugawa shogunate as a physician and as a translator of Dutch. He was the older brother of author and rangaku scholar Morishima Chūryō.
